prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: A Way Up; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: World Discovery classroom table with a model public library, same afternoon. The library is a plain cream block building on a 4-centimeter platform; no written signs. Kit and Zoe remain beside the model.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One red four-wheeled toy cart carrying one blue book-shaped block; One cream model library on a fixed 4-centimeter-high platform; One smooth short tan ramp and one smooth longer tan ramp with the same width and surface
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Cart below platform; no ramp installed.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: World Discovery classroom table with a model public library, same afternoon. The library is a plain cream block building on a 4-centimeter platform; no written signs. Kit and Zoe remain beside the model. The red cart with one blue book block sits at the foot of the model library’s raised platform; Kit and Zoe examine the step. Exact state: Cart below platform; no ramp installed.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.
Prop engineering: one low platform about four centimeters tall relative to the tabletop toys, not a human-sized stair. Cart has exactly four wheels, a red open tray, and one blue book-shaped load. Two separate flat smooth tan boards differ ONLY in length, never width/thickness; neither is installed yet.

visualReview.note: Reference inspected: red open four-wheel cart with one blue book load, cream model library on a low fixed platform, two tan boards of matched width/thickness and different lengths, same cast. Initial view has no installed ramp; classroom scale and neutral design consistent.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent visual review; no classroom or physical-device observation.
